question: does reproducing a published 3-decimal R@1 through a seed subset of size 3-5 constitute evidence of provenance?
verdict: A subset match is not evidence. 5392 subsets of size 3-5 exist; their means round to only 338 distinct 3-decimal values, so a uniform spread over that grid would hit any chosen target about 0.30% of the time. Observed hit rates for the three published values are 0.679: 13 subsets (0.24%), 0.651: 4 subsets (0.07%), 0.621: 11 subsets (0.20%). Reporting a subset match as the source of a published cell would therefore be a ~1-in-338 coincidence, and these artefacts must be described as NOT reproducible from any group's complete seed set.
